ArtworkLayout.description: Source-provided artwork geometry and collection navigation.

finish_downloads.description:
When this client is the last to leave and background operation is off,
keep the engine running until no download is queued or running, then
stop. Without it, the engine stops soon after the last client leaves and
unfinished downloads continue at its next start. Command-line and agent
clients that submit work and leave set it; an interactive application
whose window close should stop downloads leaves it unset.

releases.description: Omit for all matching releases in the frozen snapshot.

finish_downloads.description:
Whether the engine recorded `finish_downloads` for this client. Absent
on engines released before that attach option.

recommendation_basis.description: Honest explanation of source-provided or similarity-based recommendations.

oneOf.description: A standalone media item with no declared parent collection.

CollectionLink.description: Small, source-provided discovery facts. No executable presentation or social actions.

duration_seconds.description: Duration and audience facts supplied by a media source, including flat listings.

parent.description: The containing collection, such as the channel that published a video.

published_label.description: Source display text (for example “2 hours ago”); never treated as an exact date.

secure.description: Absent attributes keep the earlier engine defaults: Secure and HttpOnly.

tag_search.description: Query this discovery operation with a query (including empty for popular tags).

request_intervals.description: Additional pacing for upstream endpoints with a stricter limit than ordinary browsing.

ImageSummary.description: A downloadable image post. One release contains every image in the post.

LabelAppearance.description: A source's label color, never arbitrary CSS or executable presentation.

OriginStorage.description:
Page storage for one credential-authorized HTTPS origin, such as a site's
signed-in session marker. Engine-owned like cookies; never sent to plugins.

generation.description: Artifact-set version, assigned by the engine before confirmation.

account_mode.description:
Preferred reference-UI connection method. Imports store credentials without
asserting authentication; browser completion remains engine-owned.

capabilities.description:
The operations this source implements (such as `search`, `releases`
and `resolve`), plus `collection_hint` when its `resolve` reads the
request's `collection_hint`.

sign_in.description:
Used only by the interactive engine-owned sign-in browser. These grants
are never handed to source HTTP, media, or browser broker operations.

preview.description: Metadata for browsing the release without fetching each item's details.

ReleaseOrder.description: Explicit chapter browsing order. Absent for complete acquisition/subscription scans.

SameSite.description: Browser SameSite policy. An absent value keeps the earlier engine default (Lax).

outcomes.description: Checked release outcomes, independent of preview pagination.

executable_sha256.description: Absent on engines released before manual-update handover support.

origins.description: Restored before page scripts run in engine-owned source browsers only.

for_update.description:
Suspend this profile's startup registration for replacement/uninstall.
The background preference is preserved and restored on the next launch.

completion_cookies.description:
Cookie names required before saving an authenticated source session.
Values stay inside the engine and are never exposed to plugins or clients.

SignInWindow.description:
`isolated`: the engine's confined browser, shown to the client as frames.
`native`: a window using the operating system's web view, opened by the
engine on its desktop session. Native windows pass site checks that reject
automated browsers, but the page uses the ordinary network connection.

release_refs.description: Explicit image posts selected in discovery, frozen one at a time.

SourceInvocation.description:
Frontends describe a source operation. The engine supplies its clock and all
execution authority; clients need not construct the worker's internal request.

StorageItem.description: One local-storage entry restored only into its own HTTPS origin.

name.description: Optional name shown in subscriptions, independent of the source title.

search.description: Saved discovery input. Search subscriptions observe matching items, not their releases.

title.description: Cached source collection title with any user title override applied.

adminClient.description: Profile administration token: installation, activation and service shutdown. Keep out of ordinary frontend network requests.

normalClient.description: Profile normal-client token: read and manage operations.

info.description: One service per user profile. Read the private instance descriptor, attach a lease, and use the normal token for ordinary workflows. Heartbeat every 15 seconds. Native folder pickers and external opening belong to the shell; the engine owns file changes. Snapshot event_cursor before querying resources, then reconnect from the last applied event. Collections use server-side cursor pagination; always follow next_cursor until null.
info.title: OMD acquisition engine
